description: This file defines the PersistableProductReview class, which extends ProductReviewEntity and implements Serializable. It adds a customerId field with getter and setter methods for persisting product reviews associated with a customer.

classes.name: PersistableProductReview
classes.description: A class representing a persistable product review, including a customer ID for association with a customer.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the product review.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID associated with the product review.

search-terms: Java class for product review persistence
